description: Frozen guest clone/fetch semantics as pure expected-operation plans (acquisitions/git/jail/semantics.py); G3 application with real local Git must reproduce them. Expected outcomes are written literally, not computed by the planner. acquired describes the delivered copy: canonical repository, optional advertised head branch, ascending refs, each with its raw id (oid; a tag object for annotated tags) and its fully peeled object (peeled type and id). Raw and peeled data are facts G3 must verify locally in the delivered repository; a plan only checks their consistency. A branch is a direct commit (peeled commit id equal to its raw id). Clone: destination is missing, empty or nonempty; refs are the created local refs with raw ids; checkout.commit is the peeled commit HEAD points at; config is the only persistent configuration planned. Fetch: urls and fetch are the remote's configured values; local are existing fully qualified local refs, unique (refs/remotes/<remote>/HEAD stands for its symref target); current is the checked-out branch, unborn when explicitly marked, and its configured upstream (a remote or . for a local branch), absent when detached; updates, unchanged and retained cover tracking refs and tags only, with raw ids; fetch_head entries are ordered merge-eligible first. A successful plan's complete resulting namespace never holds a ref and another below it (git_ref_conflict otherwise; nothing pruned). invalid: inputs that must be refused with the fixed git_semantics_input_invalid before any plan; array holes cannot be written in JSON and are tested directly. Generated by build/git-acquisition-1/g0-4/gen-fixtures.mjs.
